issues.description: Function parameter annotation mismatch for build_msd_circ: the problem statement declares the third parameter as 'y_states: tuple[int]' while both the template implementation (template_repository/msd.py) and the reference solution (solution_repository/msd.py) use 'y_states: list[int]'. This inconsistency concerns the expected collection type for the resource-qubit indices and can confuse students about whether to accept/return a tuple or list (or whether either is allowed) when implementing or calling build_msd_circ.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter annotation consistent across artifacts. Prefer updating the problem statement signature to 'y_states: list[int]' to match the template and solution, and add a clarifying sentence in the task text stating that either a sequence (list or tuple) of int indices is acceptable. Alternatively, change the template and solution signatures to 'tuple[int]' if tuples are preferred. Ensure the task text explicitly allows any sequence/iterable of ints if flexibility is intended.
